# Color Profile

## Summary
How an image's pixels are encoded: colour space, depth, channels and alpha.

## Shape
`colorSpace` is a `CodedValueField` over the `color-space` vocabulary (`srgb`, `display-p3`,
`adobe-rgb`, `rec2020`, `grayscale`, `indexed`, `ycbcr`, `cmyk`, `uncalibrated`), so an
unrecognized profile is preserved rather than coerced to sRGB. `iccProfile` keeps the embedded
profile name when there is one. `hasAlphaLabel` is computed for display.

## Example
```ts
import { ColorProfileField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(ColorProfileField);
```
